question.html:
The diagram shows the position of three stars and a planet and the distances between the stars and the planet. The mass of each star is kg. 

a. Outline Newton's universal law of gravitation.

  [2]

b. Find the gravitational field strength at the position of the planet due to Star B. Include an appropriate unit with your answer.

  [2]

c. Find the magnitude and the direction of the resultant gravitational field strength at the position of the planet.

  [4]
